title: NEW LICENSE REQUIREMENT
text:
NATIONAL INSURANCE COMMISSION
REQUIREMENTS FOR OPERATIONAL LICENCES OF INSURANCE, REINSURANCE,
INSURANCE BROKING, REINSURANCE BROKING COMPANIES, TECHNICAL SERVICE
PROVIDERS, LOSS ADJUSTERS AND LOSS ASSESSORS
Applicants can only be bodies corporate incorporated in Ghana. The application shall
be accompanied by the following;
1. Copy of Certificate of Incorporation
2. Copies of documents filed at the Office of the Registrar of Companies (ORC)
showing the details of shareholding structure and the Board of Directors
3. Beneficial Ownership Profile document from the ORC
4. The details of each shareholder are as follows;
In the case of a natural person;
• Name
• Nationality
• Country of residence
• CV, completed Personal Questionnaire and Personality Notes Form
• Any other relevant information.
In the case of a body corporate,
• Name
• Nature of Business
• Company’s detailed organizational structure
• Detailed group structure (if applicable), indicating the chain of connection/showing
all associated and affiliated companies to the ultimate owners
• Country of residence
• The company’s Audited Financial Statement for the last five years and
• Any other relevant information.
5. Curriculum Vitae completed Personal Questionnaire and Personality Notes Form
from each Shareholder (in the case of public companies, only significant holders
owning 10% or more need to provide their details), Director, Principal Officers (at
least 2) and proposed Chief Finance Officer/ Finance Manager (in the case of a
Technical Service Provider).

6. A detailed 5-year Business Plan containing relevant projections (3 years for
Broking, Technical Service Providers, Loss Adjusting firms and Loss Assessors).
7. Evidence of availability of minimum required capital and its source; Reinsurance
Company GH₵125million (for each class of business), Insurance Company
GH₵50million, Reinsurance Broking Company GH₵1million, Broking/Technical
Service Providers/Loss Adjusting Companies GH₵500,000, and Loss Assessor
GH₵200,000. At least 60% of the minimum capital requirements must be in cash
or cash equivalent.
8. An audited Statement of Affairs showing all assets and liabilities (valuation
reports for motor vehicle(s), building(s) and properties with titles).
9. Proposed insurance products including proposal forms, policy wordings and rates.
10. Particulars of and letter of consent from Auditor, including the digital address of
auditors.
11. In the case of Life companies, particulars and a letter of consent from Actuary.
12. Copies of all contracts regulating the applicant’s relationship with all other
companies transferring the applicant’s functions to other companies and any
other contracts, the contents of which influence the financial situation of the
applicant.
13. The latest audited financial statement of the applicant, audited accounts of the
immediate parent and consolidated group accounts, if any.
14. A description of the location of office accommodation to be approved by the
National Insurance Commission, including the digital address and receipt of
payment of rent.
15. A non-refundable Application fee of GH₵10,000 for Technical Service
Providers/Loss Assessors, GH₵26,000 for Insurance Brokers/ Loss Adjusters,
GH₵52,000 for Reinsurance Brokers, GH₵65,000 for Insurers, GH₵97,500 for
Reinsurers and $25,000 for Foreign Reinsurers/Reinsurance Contact Office
respectively. A licence fee will be charged if the application is approved.
NOTE:
a) The application file will be closed if you fail to respond to licence application queries
after a period of four (4) months and the process will have to be restarted anew.

b) A Technical Service Provider may sell both Life and Non-Life microinsurance
products.
